signal_families.description: Evidence bootstrap and QA gating remain operationally central

lora.evidence: Behavioral evidence (merge accuracy) available for 2/3 cases. QA gating dominates triage in all field trial inventories. Strict-QA blocks unknown/weak sources.

loha.evidence: All 3 adapters are unknown_no_behavioral_eval. Strict-QA blocks all 3 pairs. Evidence bootstrap remains binding constraint despite successful structural audit.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: 4 sources, all behavioral_missing. QA flagged 1 source weak (qnli_s42: diffuse_delta_spectrum). Triage reduced 6 pairs to 1. Policy summary: 'Source QA is the binding constraint.'

signal_families.notes: QA/evidence gating is the single most portable signal. It operates identically across all three artifact classes: missing or weak behavioral evidence triggers the same triage narrowing regardless of representation form.

signal_families.description: Same-task pairs are more compatible than cross-task pairs

lora.evidence: Same-task SST-2 pair retained (merge acc 0.876). Cross-task SST-2 x AG News excluded as control (0.842 but low compatibility 0.111). Sidecar S01: same-task always safe, cross-task variable.

loha.evidence: All 3 pairs are same-task. No cross-task LoHa pairs exist. Cannot test separation.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: Same-task compatibility 0.892 vs cross-task mean 0.704. Same-minus-cross separation = 0.188. Triage retained only same-task pair.

signal_families.notes: Confirmed in LoRA and checkpoint delta. Cannot be tested in LoHa (same-task only panel). The ordering is consistent: same-task > cross-task in both classes where testable.

signal_families.description: Same-family pairs behave distinctly from both same-task and cross-task

lora.evidence: MNLI x QNLI (NLI family): moderate routing confusability (score 0.379), distinct from same-task (high confusability 0.481) and cross-task separable pairs (0.222). In merge: compatibility 0.431, between same-task 0.475 and cross-task 0.111.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: SST-2 x Yelp (sentiment_binary family): compatibility 0.652, between same-task 0.892 and cross-task 0.626. Risk high, but routed to same-family informational caution rather than exclusion.

signal_families.notes: Same-family occupies an intermediate position in both LoRA and checkpoint delta. The exact position varies (closer to cross-task in checkpoint deltas, more centered in LoRA), but the three-way ordering same_task > same_family > cross_task holds in both classes where testable.

signal_families.description: The workflow reduces candidate space to a smaller, useful subset

lora.evidence: Field trial inventories show 90%+ candidate reduction. Inventory 02: 10 pairs to 1 retained. Inventory 03: 36 pairs to 3 retained. Triage + evidence gating consistently reduces to actionable subset.

loha.evidence: 3 pairs retained from 3 (no exclusion by structural risk), but all 3 blocked by strict-QA (unknown behavioral evidence). Net result: 0 actionable without behavioral bootstrap. Narrowing is driven by evidence gating.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: 6 pairs reduced to 1 retained. 'Candidate space reduced from 6 pairs to 1.' Cross-task excluded, weak source excluded, only same-task seed pair survives.

signal_families.notes: Conservative narrowing works across all three classes. The narrowing mechanism is consistent: QA evidence gating + task relation boundary + structural risk. The workflow shape (broad input -> narrow output) survives representation change.

signal_families.description: Middle categories (near-miss, marginal) recur between retained and excluded

lora.evidence: Near-miss confirmed as distinct product category in field trials (7 pairs, avg delta vs best = -0.006). Near-miss substantial case in panel (merge acc 0.606, triage role near_miss_substantial). Behavioral data shows near-miss is safe, not fragile precursor.

loha.evidence: All 3 pairs are low risk, all same-task. No near-miss or marginal cases emerged. Panel too homogeneous to produce middle states.

checkpoint_delta.evidence: No pairs explicitly categorized as near-miss. The same-task pair (medium risk, 0.892 compatibility) is the closest to a near-miss probe, but QA dominance prevented the near-miss/retained distinction from emerging. Near-miss severity fields are empty in Stage C results.

signal_families.notes: Near-miss is well-validated in LoRA but has not yet emerged in LoHa or checkpoint delta panels. This may be a panel coverage gap (both non-LoRA panels are too small/homogeneous) rather than a representation-specific signal. The absence is inconclusive.
